verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a pip-installable Python library (AgentChat) whose agents/teams are created and run purely in code, and AutoGen Studio explicitly supports exporting teams to run as Python code or in a Docker container — both point to headless/automatable execution outside any GUI. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, GitHub Actions workflow, or documented headless CLI flag in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline example/config, documented headless mode or CLI runner, independent confirmation of unattended automated runs.
